lines.text: How have the knees been since last time?
Since last time the right one's been worse on the stairs, the left is behaving.
Since last time the morning stiffness lasts about twenty minutes, I don't really time it though.
Sorry I'm late, couldn't find a parking space.
Hello, come in, grab that chair. We're just getting going.
She's been limping a lot more since last time, especially after the shopping.
That's useful to know. Let me have a look at the right knee.
There's fluid around the knee and a creaky feel when it bends, and it's a bit warm.
I think you have a flare of the arthritis in that knee.
You're going to take naproxen 500 milligrams twice a day with omeprazole 20 milligrams once a day for the stomach, for two weeks.
Okay. Can I still do my aqua aerobics?
Yes, the water's ideal, just keep the kicks gentle, and use a stick in your left hand on bad days.
I'll dig the stick out of the loft.
Perfect. Same time in three weeks then.
